cases.defense: Reject parent traversal that crosses a provider root.
Canonicalize WSL aliases without conflating Linux case-sensitive identity or accepting an overlong canonical result.
Do not follow symlinks, junctions, or reparse points outside an operation root; exclusive empty-file creation refuses a final dangling link and preserves its absent target.

Revalidate Windows local or WSL source file identity and rewrite metadata, provider boundary, destination containment, and collision at the mutation boundary; empty-file creation requires the original direct parent and refuses late collisions without overwrite; the create-new artifact owner registers possible creation before native effects, fixes the first stable identity, preserves evidence on failed or contradictory later observations, and never retries creation or deletes during disposal; preparation rechecks the first original/desired byte baselines and exact initial recovery frame, including EOF, while native artifact admission observes streams after its final path check; post-content observation uses the same held root/ancestor/path/stable-object chain and never refreshes original full-identity consent.

Report exact completed effects when cancellation arrives during composite work or an admitted atomic empty-file creation; a successful creation retains FileCreated and progress1/1; artifact receipts retain known stable object identity with explicit full-metadata knowledge and cannot hide target or duplicate aliases behind an unobserved full identity; bounded recovery records distinguish valid incomplete append prefixes from malformed complete records and bind completion to the exact initial frame even when tokens repeat; held-content primitives refuse successful evidence after cancellation and retain actual partial write or truncate effects for the enclosing attempt to report; preparation retains historical verified content on read-only failure, records flush uncertainty before the native call and acknowledgement before observing later cancellation; the one overwrite attempt records target uncertainty before its first native write/truncate, preserves untouched state on earlier read/cancel, and retains complete desired verification before later cancellation without inventing cleanup or copy completion.

Resolve case and normalization collisions through one explicit conflict decision; pending conflicts, allowed choices and plans retain owned immutable snapshots without mutable synchronization storage; resumed plans retain the exact original target binding and reject contradictory file evidence or source/target aliases.

Carry verified descendant identities, exact streamed-byte comparison and SHA-256 evidence to source-provider deletion; revalidate source, target, the original ancestor directory objects (object component, non-link) and remaining membership before recorded-only nonrecursive deletion, reanchor only the direct parent after owned removal, and report partial source effects without claiming an atomic tree; verified children and ancestors retain exactly the one validated immutable snapshot.
Reject ordinary deletion with unrequested capability before any batch effect, even with confirmation; require capability-bound explicit confirmation for known permanent deletion.
Use fixed non-shell WSL discovery arguments, validate distribution output, and prevent command injection through names and path text.
Prevent credentials and sensitive full paths from reaching diagnostics.
Bound and cancel hostile large or recursively changing Windows local, UNC, and WSL enumerations; retain owned immutable published entry snapshots.

Reject malformed, oversized, unknown-version, unsupported-language, partially written, concurrently changed, or reparse-redirected settings; preserve the approved ancestor anchor, reject document reparse entries, select one injected temporary candidate without retry or foreign-residue cleanup, freeze owned temporary identity from its open handle, revalidate exact destination and temporary bytes, and publish through the provider-atomic install.

Never interpret IME or text-editor input as Vim or destructive commands; filter completion keys retain press ownership across native editor exit, and stale exits cannot steal replacement-editor focus.

Reject duplicate and reentrant operation dispatch deterministically, including name submission, empty-file creation and exact-owner menu callbacks; stale, disabled, foreign or already consumed candidates never dispatch; exact filter text, exit and blur callbacks cannot alter a replacement editor; conflict modal submissions require the exact displayed operation and cannot decide or cancel a later conflict; the native overwrite attempt consumes prepared state before its first await and refuses concurrent, failed, cancelled or completed reentry.

Reject Windows device names including the six COM/LPT superscript 1-3 stems with case and extension handling, ambiguous roots, invalid UNC shares, overlong canonical paths, and unrepresentable provider entry segments; WSL parsing preserves Linux names and Infrastructure uses extended-length text so that no segment is renamed by Win32 normalization.

Freeze source and destination identities when pane activation changes mid-operation; keep accepted operation sources and resumed preflight batches owned and unchanged through public collection reads, synchronization storage and provider callbacks; filtering permanently drops invisible marks before target capture and cannot modify pending operation subjects.
Normalize Windows local, UNC, and WSL permission or availability changes without widening access or retry scope; distinguish an observed creation collision from a denied absent target.
Stop a batch before mutation when any source fails complete preflight or required capability discovery; preserve the exact frozen inspection capability through transfer preflight and conflict resume.

Activate one admitted local, UNC or WSL path through the existing execution boundary, or reveal it through the existing STA Shell boundary; activation refuses roots while explicit reveal may select them. Preserve bounded UNC/WSL lengths and compatible WSL names, release each parsed PIDL exactly once, observe cancellation before final handoff, normalize network/credential failures without retry, and never interpret path text as command syntax or supply credentials.

Reject a Windows-side WSL entry whose replacement restores inode, kind, length, and last-write time by way of change time or link count; never share one identity between a link and its target; and refuse the 9P identity form on any other file system.
Fail an unreachable, timed-out, dropped, or unauthenticated UNC share read closed as AccessDenied or ProviderUnavailable with no listing, retry, credential prompt, or fallback to another provider.

Route copy and move between Windows local and one WSL distribution or between WSL distributions with one source distribution per batch, derive every target and descendant with the destination provider's rules, reject existing or duplicate targets as Conflict without merging, repeat typed admission during copy and verification, fail denied WSL mounts and unsupported pairs closed, and keep the source after failure; only the gateway deletes a source after its verification succeeds.

Recycle Windows entries only through the guarded Shell recycle operation on an owned STA; veto permanent or unexpected effects before deletion, require a completed recycle receipt, preserve confirmed partial effects and never retry as permanent deletion.

Query current OS drive facts through one boundary and refuse network, unknown or missing drive roots before local identity, source/destination mutation, recursive transfer, verified source deletion and settings publication/cleanup; repeat admission after preflight, preserve prior effects and unsafe-cleanup residue, and never treat display facts or a drive letter as a local-storage capability.
